ValidationRule.description: #SFCPQBLG-482 When Apply Invoice Minimum Charges is checked, then Invoice Minimum Start Date and Invoice Minimum Charges are Required
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.Disable_VR__c && OR( ISBLANK($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c), CONTAINS($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c, 'Account') )),NOT(ISBLANK( ParentId )),RecordType.DeveloperName = $Label.QTB_AccountRecordType_Billing, QTB_Apply_Invoice_Minimum_Charges__c=true, OR(ISBLANK( QTB_Invoice_Minimum_Start_Date__c ),ISBLANK( QTB_Invoice_Minimum_Charges__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Invoice Minimum Start Date and Invoice Minimum Charges are required if Apply Invoice Minimum Charges is Checked.
